name: spreadsheetGetCellFormat
description: Returns a struct of the formatting applied to a cell.

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. Returns only the keys the cell's style sets: bold, italic, fontsize, font, color, bgcolor, alignment, verticalalignment, wraptext and dataformat. Colors are #RRGGBB strings. Member form: getCellFormat(row, column).

examples.title: Read back a format
examples.description: Format a cell, then read the format struct back.
